details.text: Leading strategic product engineering and architectural consulting for startups and scale-ups, focusing on high-velocity code execution and scalable digital products.
Fullstack Engineering & engineering leadership with architectural strategy and roadmaps for industrial clients. Established standards for API design, DevOps, and cloud infrastructure.
Architected the HX Contentful CMS migration and optimized publishing workflows. Implemented high-performance destination pages using React and TypeScript for the TravelHX website.

As Technical Lead, I drove an enterprise-scale digital transformation for Shell Energy Australia. I designed a micro-frontend architecture that enabled team autonomy and led the hands-on migration of mission-critical ERM portals to React.

Previously, as a Senior Engineer, I focused on high-performance frontend delivery, building core portfolio products for the RES B2B market segment and establishing modular patterns for future modernization.
Developed NFT marketplaces for the SWSX Festival and built specialized entertainment projects for FOX and the WWE using React.
Design and Implementation of text, audio and video chat between mobile app and web interface using library called PubNub.
Acted as React Subject Matter Expert to lead the development of the company-wide Intranet and fixed critical financial tools like the Stamp Duty Calculator.
Led the Prospecting Team through mentoring and code reviews while managing full-stack development across React frontends and .NET/C# APIs.
Engineered core modules for Education and Game Management Systems (GMS) serving the RFU and FA. Built automated build and deployment pipelines using TeamCity to improve engineering efficiency.
Initially joining as a Junior Engineer, I focused on SQL Server database design and troubleshooting web applications while developing responsive features following the MVC design pattern.
